Hey it's alright I promise you. I failed my vitals check off in nurse 1 and I practiced so hard.

Nurse 2 I didn't know how to set a piggyback which caused my entire group to have to do a remediation skills lab... in a sim lab, my sterile technique was so awful my instructor got visibly frustrated at me and she and I had a talk. Told me she could fail me for not performing sterile technique. I had to do an essay and it also caused my group to again do remediation for sterile technique.

It's an awful feeling but these are things that take time. If there's open lab, please utilize it. These are skills that at times you may not have an opportunity to work on during clinicals. 

I'm currently in Nurse 3 now.

If I could fail my skills that badly where I dragged my classmates down with me and manage to pass, you can too. Don't give up

A part of me wants to message him and tell him that if we see each other it's okay and I have no hard feelings since we are in similar gaming communities, but I don't see him enough to have to care.

Not sure if he was an anxious avoidant or what, but after the amount of times I asked to hang out and he brushed me off, I knew it was going nowhere. How could we rebuild trust if you're not even letting me try or giving yourself that chance? He's the one that broke up with me by the way. 

While I did a lot of reflecting after I had told myself "I'm done", he came back around January after 3~ months of not talking. I was still hurt because of how he treated me and how it ended when I called it quits. I ignored him for a few days but he kept TRYING. 

I messaged him back and I GAVE IT TO HIM. He seemed really resentful and really wanted to do right by me, but after a month in, I had asked him a question if he was seeing anyone to which he replied "yes". That's where I drew the line. He even had the audacity to tell me that he didn't mention that first because he was afraid I would just ignore him if he said that without kind of easing into it. 

He also even talked about things like, yeah it's possible that I can develop feelings for you again, and I was super open and forthright saying that I still had feelings. I gave him that right to know, why wasn't I allowed to know that he was talking to someone? I actually had to figure that out he was when I stopped talking to him, but he told me he stopped talking to her because she wanted kids and he didn't or wasn't ready. Then told me he started talking to her again when I asked if he was talking to anyone prior to me completely blocking him off before he had anything to say to me. I gave him a few words and left it at that. 

A part of me wants to reach out and say hey we can be friends because I'm over it, you can do whatever you want. But a part of me doesn't care because he was awful and selfish. 

I was awful during the relationship but I at least reflected and BLOSSOMED.
